name: google-gmail
summary: Google's hosted Gmail MCP server with your own Google OAuth client (read-only scopes)

connect.description: Google Gmail (hosted MCP, own OAuth client)

notes: Same setup as the google-drive template: a Google Cloud project, the API and its MCP API enabled, an OAuth consent screen, an OAuth client with redirect http://127.0.0.1:8977/callback; lotr setup asks for the client id and secret as references.
Scope gmail.compose (drafts and sending) is not requested; add it to connect.scopes only if you want drafts, and sending still asks first.
Tool names are not on Google's page, so none is named here: a name is rated by its words (a read word is a read, anything unknown is a write, send and delete ask first).
